scope: M1 and M2 runtime repair only. M3 measurement and full13 harness corrections remain with the author lane. No native, scientific, production, receiving or merge claim.

m1.defect: PsycheStore.finish accepted a result without an effects-receipt link; forged receipt_ref and accessible surface were not checked.
repair: p3_owner._result now records the durable effects receipt hash in consequences and uses P3_PSYCH:<receipt.response_hash> as receipt_ref.
p3_owner._effect binds the actor/user projection into the effects receipt before finish.

state_store._validate_result requires an effects-receipt hash link, the exact receipt response-hash ref, and receipt-bound accessible/actor-surface equality when the receipt carries projection evidence.
state_store.commit_effects accepts optional compression/projection evidence, includes both in request_hash, and stores them plus content hashes before receipt_hash.

m2.defect: compression.bind ran after commit_effects; a failure in that window left PSYCH_COMMITTED and recovery completed without compression evidence.
repair: p3_owner._effect computes compression.bind before commit_effects and passes the envelope into the receipt.
PSYCH_COMMITTED recovery reads compression and projection from the durable receipt in _existing_effect; it never recomputes or drops them.
state_store.finish rejects a result whose compression evidence differs from the receipt.
m2.test: tests/test_p3_owner.py::test_compression_evidence_survives_psych_committed_crash injects a finish failure after PSYCH_COMMITTED, closes the owner, cold-reopens the exact P2/P3 roots, completes recovery, and asserts the receipt compression envelope is preserved byte-for-byte in the result.

actual_commands: python3 -m pytest tests/test_compression.py tests/test_projections.py tests/test_projection_receiving.py tests/test_rules.py -q
environment_note: The host volume was at 100% capacity (190 MiB free) during the first evidence run; one store test failed to open SQLite with disk I/O error. Old temporary pytest/opencode artifacts were removed (regenerable, no repository or user document data), the single case passed immediately, and the full logged run above is clean. Full vertical-suite execution is not claimed here; the author lane owns that harness and matrix.
